columns.name: firm
columns.meaning: the registry-derived firm scope this row belongs to; never a typed token

columns.name: account_id
columns.meaning: the custodian account id in the declaration's account form (10-char zero-padded)

columns.name: business_date
columns.meaning: the valuation day, the custodian's own

columns.name: lot_id
columns.meaning: the lot event id, security, acquired date and original purchase date joined by '|': the event id alone repeats within an account

columns.name: ticker_symbol
columns.meaning: the custodian's ticker, blank where it carries none

columns.name: cusip
columns.meaning: the security's CUSIP, blank where it carries none

columns.name: quantity
columns.meaning: the open quantity of the lot

columns.name: acquired_date
columns.meaning: the lot's acquired date as the custodian states it; null on ACQUIRED_DATE_ABSENT; a date before 2010 is kept

columns.name: holding_term
columns.meaning: the custodian's holding-term flag read through the producer's declared map

columns.name: holding_trading_days
columns.meaning: trading days in [acquired_date, business_date]; null on PRE_2010_OPENED and ACQUIRED_DATE_ABSENT

columns.name: cost_basis
columns.meaning: the lot's cost basis as basis_source says: the custodian's cost_basis_unamortized (the column satisfying market_value - cost_basis == unrealized_gain, chosen by measurement) where basis_source is CUSTODIAN, otherwise the re-measured basis (see basis_source)

columns.name: unrealized_gain
columns.meaning: market_value less cost_basis: the custodian's own unrealized_gain_loss where basis_source is CUSTODIAN, otherwise re-measured from the re-measured basis

columns.name: custodian_cost_basis
columns.meaning: the custodian's own cost_basis_unamortized for the lot (rows sharing the lot id summed), carried beside cost_basis and never used in the activity identity when basis_source is not CUSTODIAN

columns.name: basis_source
columns.meaning: where cost_basis comes from: CUSTODIAN (the custodian's own basis), IN_KIND_TRANSFER_VALUE (the lot arrived in kind: measured from its market value on the transfer date) or WASH_SALE_EXCLUDED_BASIS (the custodian's basis carries a disallowed loss no cash paid for: measured from the cash paid, basis less the disallowed loss)

columns.name: source_rows
columns.meaning: how many custodian rows made this lot's figures: rows sharing the lot id are one lot to this table and are summed

columns.name: method_version
columns.meaning: the method this figure was produced under (3)

columns.name: coverage
columns.meaning: why a calendar-derived column is null; MEASURED where none is

i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.coverage: domain: 'why is a calendar-derived column of this lot null'. MEASURED (none is) | PRE_2010_OPENED (the lot was opened before lib/trading_calendar.py's floor of 2010-01-01, which raises there: holding_trading_days is null and the custodian's dates are kept) | ACQUIRED_DATE_ABSENT (the custodian row has no acquired date). COVERED BY SUBTRACTION: a lot either carries an acquired date or not; one that does is either on or after the floor or before it.
i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.holding_term: domain: the custodian's holding-term flag. LONG_TERM | SHORT_TERM. A flag outside the declared map REFUSES.

rule24_record.ii_same_grain: Every member is a LOT property on a valuation day.
rule24_record.iii_intent_coherence: coverage answers ONE question -- why a calendar-derived column of this lot is null -- and says nothing about the lot's gain.
rule24_record.iv_state_coherence: The calendar gaining pre-2010 coverage moves PRE_2010_OPENED only; a custodian row gaining an acquired date moves ACQUIRED_DATE_ABSENT only.

member_evidence.live_run: 160549 lot-day rows over 24 trading days for the sampled accounts: MEASURED 159669, PRE_2010_OPENED 880. On the end day, 1282 open lots before 2010 across ALL accounts.
member_evidence.unexercised_members_proved_by_test: ACQUIRED_DATE_ABSENT is 0 on live data; test_an_absent_acquired_date_is_a_named_coverage_not_a_guess produces it.

basis_source.i_mece_over_a_declared_domain: domain: 'where does this lot's cost_basis come from'. CUSTODIAN (the custodian's basis stands) | IN_KIND_TRANSFER_VALUE (the lot arrived in kind) | WASH_SALE_EXCLUDED_BASIS (the custodian's basis carries a disallowed loss). COVERED BY SUBTRACTION: a lot either arrived in kind or not; one that did not either carries a disallowed loss or not; the producer sets the in-kind source first and it takes precedence over the wash-sale one, so each lot is in exactly one member and the rest are CUSTODIAN.
basis_source.ii_same_grain: Every member is a LOT property; none speaks of an account or a day.
basis_source.iii_intent_coherence: basis_source answers ONE question, where the basis figure was measured from, and nothing else; coverage (why a calendar-derived column is null) and closing_tie (how a realized lot ties to its transaction) are separate columns.
basis_source.iv_state_coherence: WHICH VALUES ONE REMEDY DOES NOT MOVE. basis_source is moved by exactly two producer rules (an in-kind reference, a wash-sale carry-over) and by no other; neither rule moves coverage, closing_tie or custodian_cost_basis, which keeps the custodian's own figure beside the measured one.
basis_source.token_census: comp-find word-boundary regex (WASH_SALE_EXCLUDED_BASIS|IN_KIND_TRANSFER_VALUE) over the worktree corpus (corpus=all): 26 hit(s) across 61,428 file(s) scanned, 24 ephemeral-floor, 1 unreadable and 3,695 binary files not searched; first-party definition in the producer only (DEF=2 bands), the rest are this project's records, task orders and the checker. CUSTODIAN is the custody vocabulary's own word and is adopted by the producer's constant BASIS_CUSTODIAN; no other schema in org/standards carries a basis_source column.

schema_hash_basis: sha256 over the sorted 'name:type' lines joined by newline, types as the pyarrow type name the producer's ARROW_* schema carries -- the method that reproduces account_return_daily's published hash 1b25d37b... exactly. The check recomputes it against the landed parquet, so contract and artifact cannot drift.
firm_specific_columns: NONE. No Schwab code survives into this table (no tr_cd, sb_cd, h_t, l_s, close_event_id column); the custodian's lot-table and column names are declared in sources.json (the custody entry's lot_source), which the producer reads through lot_spec(); row IRPT_DASHBD-W20-S1 closed.
producer_pin: data/assets/scripts/gold/irpt_reporting/account_activity_lots.py -- the ARROW_UNREALIZED schema this hash is taken from (method_version 3, schema_version 1.2). The producer and this contract land together.
limits_of_method_version_1: method_version 1: the custodian's tax-status slices are read as one source (they are disjoint by account on the end day measured) and no slice column is carried; rows sharing a lot id are summed. REVISED for method_version 3 (TO-DB-b-41): see the column meanings; in-kind legs are flows and departures at market value on the transfer date, fee-admin and withheld-tax cash rows are negative components of income, and a lot's basis is re-measured per basis_source.
primary_key_meaning: one row per open lot per valuation day: lot_id (event id | cusip | acquired date | original purchase date) is unique within a day and account
